title: Custom-auth provides-* boolean elicits each bind one applied-capabilities token on the sidecar
asA: operator applying the admin-console on a project running its own auth (no shipped security-auth-* blueprint)
iWant: each of the four custom-auth-provides-* boolean elicits to bind its capability token onto the sidecar's appliedCapabilities union with a per-token clause (true adds; false omits)
soThat: the shell reads the exact capability union the elicited answers produce and no downstream surface guesses at what a custom auth has declared

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the manifest elicit `blueprint.json.elicits[id=custom-auth-provides-principal-directory]` is answered `true`, the sidecar written by the elicitation phase records `principalDirectory` as a member of `appliedCapabilities`; when the same elicit is answered `false`, the sidecar records no `principalDirectory` entry in `appliedCapabilities`, per REQ-009. Applying agent sets: the boolean answer to `custom-auth-provides-principal-directory`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project running its own auth with the elicit `custom-auth-provides-principal-directory` presented at apply
acceptanceCriteria.when: the elicitation phase runs and writes the sidecar
acceptanceCriteria.then: the sidecar the shell reads records `principalDirectory` in `appliedCapabilities` when the answer is `true` and omits it when the answer is `false`
